definitions.explanation: A small, unspecified number of books or bound volumes, typically implying two to five or so. Combines the prefix {数|すう}〜 (several) with the counter {冊|さつ} (for books).

examples.japanese: {図書館|としょかん}で{数冊|すうさつ}{借|か}りてきた。
examples.english: I borrowed several books from the library.

examples.japanese: {机|つくえ}の{上|うえ}に{参考書|さんこうしょ}が{数冊|すうさつ}{積|つ}まれていた。
examples.english: Several reference books were piled on the desk.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}に{行|い}く{前|まえ}に、ガイドブックを{数冊|すうさつ}{読|よ}んで{下調|したしら}べをした。
examples.english: Before going on the trip, I read several guidebooks to do some research.

notes:
Composed of {数|すう} (several/a few) and {冊|さつ} (counter for books/volumes). The prefix {数|すう}〜 combines with many counters to express a small indefinite quantity: {数人|すうにん} (several people), {数回|すうかい} (several times), {数日|すうじつ} (several days), etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数冊|すうさつ}の{本|ほん}: several books
- {数冊|すうさつ}{持|も}っている: to have several books
- {数冊|すうさつ}{購入|こうにゅう}する: to purchase several books

RELATED EXPRESSIONS WITH {数|すう}〜:
- {数人|すうにん}: several people
- {数回|すうかい}: several times
- {数日|すうじつ}: several days
- {数台|すうだい}: several machines/vehicles
